title: Rooster Booster 3D
description:
All of the charm of Rooster Booster - now in glorious 3D! 

Rooster Booster 3D is a speed-oriented platformer inspired by retro titles that are snappy, simple, and most importantly, fun! 

Roll, bounce, and boost your way through tight turns and over death-defying jumps! Master the game's 3 playable courses by precisely timing each boost and discovering shortcuts along the way.

Each of RB3D's courses showcase a different vaporwave-style aesthetic, complimented by groovy original music! As a reward for fast completion times, players can also unlock new playable critters in addition to the Golden Torus (and if the rumors are true, gold versions of each critter).
description_short: Rooster Booster 3D is a speedy retro platformer! Play through three unique, vaporwave-inspired zones as you optimize your completion time to unlock new characters and earn the Golden Torus!
